title: Dialogue ended what discipline could not
news: Jamia's 18-day student protest ended after seven hours of talks, a fixed date for union elections and withdrawal of disciplinary cases.
syllabus: Leadership in public institutions; Emotional intelligence; Dialogue and trust
link: Punitive action deepened mistrust; credible, time-bound commitments and listening restored it. Leaders of institutions win authority by sharing voice, not by suppressing it.
question: As the head of a university facing a prolonged student protest, how would you use dialogue and emotional intelligence to resolve it?

title: Comparison as a loop
news: A mother of two teenagers writes how social media turns comparison into a loop of envy, and how to break it.
syllabus: Attitude: social influence and persuasion · Emotional intelligence · Role of family in inculcating values
link: Feeds that compare curated highlights with unfiltered lives shape attitudes; families that motivate by comparison pass the habit on, and self-awareness breaks the loop.
question: "Social media has turned comparison from an occasional act into a constant habit." Discuss its ethical implications and the role of family in building a healthy sense of self among the youth.
